entities.summary: Andrew Martin Walker is an American former professional basketball player who spent one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the New Orleans Jazz (1976–77). A small forward born in Long Island City, New York, Walker attended Niagara University and was drafted by the Jazz in the seventh round of the 1976 NBA draft.
